mapper.select: SELECT auto_convert_on_first_visit, auto_convert_on_check_in, auto_convert_on_registration, merge_on_duplicate_phone, default_org_id, contact_owner_mode, contact_owner_user_id, update_time FROM crm_lead_convert_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1

SELECT config_id, tenant_id, auto_convert_on_first_visit, auto_convert_on_check_in, auto_convert_on_registration, merge_on_duplicate_phone, default_org_id, contact_owner_mode, contact_owner_user_id, create_time, update_time FROM crm_lead_convert_config WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_lead_convert_config ( config_id, tenant_id, auto_convert_on_first_visit, auto_convert_on_check_in, auto_convert_on_registration, merge_on_duplicate_phone, default_org_id, contact_owner_mode, contact_owner_user_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{configId}, #{tenantId}, COALESCE(#{autoConvertOnFirstVisit}, true), COALESCE(#{autoConvertOnCheckIn}, true), COALESCE(#{autoConvertOnRegistration}, false), COALESCE(#{mergeOnDuplicatePhone}, true), #{defaultOrgId}, COALESCE(#{contactOwnerMode}, 'keep_lead_owner'), #{contactOwnerUserId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
